intro.line: Past the last Omenpath, the stars thin out. This is Sothera, and the stories here are about endings.
Kav miners, Eumidian gardeners, Uthros scientists and a faith that worships the dark all share one edge of the galaxy.
Recorded: the Edge of Eternities, August 2025. A new kind of Magic, set among the stars.

finale.line: The supervoid collapses on itself and the Monoist hymn goes quiet.
Beyond the edge of faith lies eternal hope.
Sunstar light reaches the Edge again. The road bends on toward whatever comes next.

villainFinale.line: In this version the dark keeps the Edge. The stars go out one by one.
All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light.
The Omenpath home flickers, and holds, just long enough for you to leave.

battles.title: Salvage Rights
battles.blurb: A skeleton crew, a patched ship and a mining claim somebody else wants.

scene.line: The hard way it is.
We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine.
Station: tap your creatures to charge a Spacecraft. When it is charged, it is a real ship.

villainScene.line: Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation.
Kav miners: the claim is ours. Dig first, argue later.

hero.half: Charge the ship with your creatures.

battles.title: The Thaw of Evendo
battles.blurb: The Eumidians are thawing a frozen moon. The Kav Navy has other ideas.

scene.line: To plant the seeds of the other is to cultivate the self.
Warp: cast it cheaper, ambush with it, and it leaves at end of turn. You can cast it again from exile later.

villainScene.line: Adapt to this, you bug-eyed planet-squatters!
Memorial Navy: advance, give everything, and hold the line.

hero.start: We grow as the world grows.
hero.half: Warp in, then warp out. The card comes back.

battles.title: The Uthros Combine
battles.blurb: Uthros scientists keep secrets. A cruel captain wants to buy them.

scene.line: The Uthros Combine's first question for any scientific breakthrough is always: "How can this be used to keep our next breakthrough secret?"
Void turns on when something leaves play or a spell is warped. Plan the turn so it lands.

villainScene.line: Your atoms will serve my ambitions in a much more useful form.
The Uthros Combine owes me a favor. I collect favors.

hero.half: Make something leave play to light Void.

battles.title: The Sunstar Free Company
battles.blurb: Light-forged knights of Sunstar against the faith that worships the dark between stars.

scene.line: Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!
Lifelink turns their damage into your life. Race, and win the exchange.

villainScene.line: All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light.
The Monoists fight a war of attrition. Victory is inevitable if they stay true.

hero.half: Gain life to stay ahead of the Faith.

battles.title: The Weft and the Wilds
battles.blurb: Drix weftwalkers cross Evendo. The newly thawed wilds have teeth.

scene.line: That which should not have happened is undone, and a new pattern takes its place.
Reach lets a creature block fliers. The wilds have a lot of reach.

villainScene.line: Oh, look at the size of those petals! That one's eaten well this season.
Evendo was frozen for ten thousand years. It is hungry.

battles.title: The Zero Point
battles.blurb: Pinnacle envoys and a fanatical knight argue about what the great destroyers left behind.

scene.line: Your ship and crew have been contaminated by the great destroyers. We cannot risk their spread. Prepare for unraveling.
Counterspells answer a spell before it resolves. Hold the mana and choose your target.

villainScene.line: A new dawn, burning away the darkness.
Death is a trick of the light. Snuff it out and discover immortality.

battles.title: The Kav Reckoning
battles.blurb: The last Kav war host runs into the Illvoi and a very patient wall of counters.

scene.line: The Kav have more than ideology or profit on the line. They fight for a home.
Illvoi control holds counters. Bait with a small spell first, then land the big one.

villainScene.line: Illvoi hope for the best outcomes but engineer for the worst.
Every spell cast into the dark is a spell we can undo.

hero.half: Bait first, then land the big spell.

battles.title: Sothera, the Supervoid
battles.blurb: Alliance against the supervoid: Sunstar light, Kav grit and one dying star.

scene.line: Beyond the edge of faith lies eternal hope.
A new dawn, burning away the darkness.
Deathtouch kills anything it damages. Trade your small creatures for their big ones.

villainScene.line: Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity.
The supervoid does not hate you. It is simply where everything ends up.

hero.low: The void is pulling us in...
hero.half: Trade small for big. Do not feed the void.

battles.title: Infinite Guideline Station
battles.blurb: The station at the heart of the Edge has one more watch to keep.

archive.what: A blue-white fleet of Station Monitors and Mechan from the set, a hub of the Edge that never sleeps.
archive.why: It stands for the station at the heart of the story and is not a list anyone won with.
archive.beat: Race it before the Mechan stack up, and keep removal for the big ship.
archive.after: Nothing; this is the optional superboss at the end of the story.

deck.name: The Station Monitors
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's set only. No tournament list is copied.

scene.line: We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine.
Keeping tabs on a whole station is too much for just one.

villainScene.line: Keeping tabs on a whole station is too much for just one.

after.line: Recorded: the station goes quiet. The Edge of Eternities lies behind you.

hero.half: Race it before the Mechan stack up.
